scenes.title: 11:49 PM
narration: At 11:49 PM, Daniel Cross was worth fourteen point seven billion dollars.
At 11:49 PM, he thought he had everything money could buy.
He was wrong.
Because the Ledger had already written his name down.

scenes.title: The Appointment
narration: Riven had collected thousands of souls.
He never cared how rich they were.
Death did not negotiate with bank accounts.
But tonight, the Ledger felt different.
dialogue: Riven: Ten minutes.
Daniel: Who are you?
Riven: Someone who already knows how this ends.

scenes.title: The Clock
narration: Daniel stared at the clock.
Ten minutes is a long time when you are waiting for something.
It is a very short time when you finally understand what you wasted.
For the first time in years, Daniel stopped thinking about money.
dialogue: Daniel: Ten minutes until what?
Riven: Until the part you cannot buy.

scenes.title: The Call
narration: Daniel opened his phone.
There was one name he had not called in three years.
His daughter.
He had sent money instead of apologies so many times that money had started to feel like an apology.
dialogue: Daniel: I know it is late.
Daniel: I just... wanted to hear your voice.
Daughter: Dad? Is everything okay?

scenes.title: What Money Couldn't Fix
narration: Daniel tried to explain.
Not the company.
Not the billions.
Just the years.
Riven watched without interrupting.
He had seen people beg for more time before.
He had rarely seen anyone use it honestly.
dialogue: Daniel: I thought giving you everything would make up for not being there.
Daughter: I did not need everything.
Daughter: I needed you.

scenes.title: The Ledger Changes
narration: Then the Ledger moved.
Riven looked down.
The time beside Daniel's name flickered.
That was impossible.
An appointed death was not supposed to change because a man finally said what he should have said years ago.
dialogue: Riven: No.
Riven: That is not how this works.

scenes.title: The Question
narration: Riven had a choice he was never supposed to have.
He could close the Ledger.
He could collect Daniel's soul.
Or he could find out why the entry had changed.
dialogue: Daniel: Am I dying?
Riven: You were.
Daniel: And now?
Riven: Now I have a question.

scenes.title: One More Minute
narration: Riven gave Daniel one more minute.
Not because Daniel was rich.
Not because Riven was merciful.
Because something had altered the Ledger.
And Riven needed to know who—or what—was behind it.
dialogue: Riven: You get one more minute.
Daniel: Why?
Riven: Because someone changed your death.
Daniel: Who?
Riven: I intend to find out.

scenes.title: 11:59 PM
narration: At 11:59 PM, Daniel's phone was still in his hand.
His daughter was still on the line.
And the Ledger was still open.
Riven turned one final page.
There was no new name.
Only a blank line.

scenes.title: The Time You Wasted
narration: Riven closed the Ledger.
Daniel had been given ten minutes.
Maybe they had changed his fate.
Maybe they had only delayed it.
Riven did not know yet.
But he knew one thing.
Ten minutes is not the time you were given.
It is the time you wasted.
dialogue: Riven: Ten minutes isn't the time you were given.
Riven: It's the time you wasted.
